acts.title: Palace in the Clouds
acts.description: Perched three hundred and fifty meters above the azure Amalfi Coast in the hilltown of Ravello.

acts.title: Pergola of Roses and Lemons
acts.description: Strolling beneath centuries-old stone pergolas draped in climbing wisteria and fragrant Amalfi lemons.
acts.fact: 💡 GARDENS: TERRACED LEMON GROVES & CENTURY-OLD ROSES

acts.title: Medieval Roman Patrician Grandeur
acts.description: Vaulted marble corridors, ancient Roman busts, and restored 18th-century ceiling frescoes.

acts.title: Pool Between Sky and Sea
acts.description: Swimming to the vanishing edge of the world's most dramatic heated cliffside infinity pool.
acts.fact: 💡 SIGNATURE: ICONIC RAVELOW CLIFF-EDGE INFINITY POOL

acts.title: Amalfi Citrus Aromatherapy
acts.description: Open-air garden massage using cold-pressed sweet almond oil and pure Ravello lemon essence.
acts.fact: 💡 WELLNESS: OPEN-AIR BOTANICAL MASSAGE IN PRIVATE GARDENS

acts.title: Belvedere Sunset Limoncello
acts.description: Sunset aperitivo on the Belvedere cliff terrace as twilight envelops the Gulf of Salerno.
acts.fact: 💡 SUNSET: GOLDEN HOUR OVER THE GULF OF SALERNO
